titel: Hotel near Museumdorp de Locht | Hotel Asteria Venray
omschrijving: Museumdorp de Locht, an open-air museum village in Melderslo, is a 14-minute drive from Hotel Asteria. What to see and how to end the day with a sauna.
hero-sub: Country life of the past in a village of farmhouses, workshops and gardens, a fourteen-minute drive from your hotel room in Venray.
hero-alt: Rebuilt brick barn with green doors and an oak tree at Museumdorp de Locht
oog-kop: Museumdorp de Locht at a glance
t1-waarde: Melderslo, municipality of Horst aan de Maas
t3-waarde: Winter Tue, Wed, Sat and Sun; April to October Tue to Sun
v1-p1: Museumdorp de Locht, an open-air museum village in Melderslo, shows how people lived, worked and ate in the countryside of North Limburg. From Hotel Asteria it is a fourteen-minute drive. You walk from a medieval farmhouse to a long-fronted farmhouse from 1859, past the baker, the smithy, the printing works and a village school.
v1-p2: The museum started in 1990 with a single farmhouse and grew into a village of more than twenty buildings and gardens. It is run entirely by volunteers. At the entrance you choose one of three museum routes, or simply walk your own loop. Allow half a day.
v1-alt: Brick bakehouse with a garden and a beech hedge at Museumdorp de Locht
v2-p1: De Locht also tells the story of market gardening in this region. The asparagus and auction building houses an auction clock from 1908; you take a seat on the benches and press the button yourself. The mushroom pavilion is shaped like half a mushroom, and in the grower's glasshouse you see the step from flat glass frames to the high-tech greenhouse.
v2-p2: On Sundays there is often something extra going on. In autumn and winter the syrup makers boil apple and beet syrup, and the blacksmith is regularly at the anvil. Coffee, Limburg vlaai (a local fruit tart), soup with bread from the village bakehouse and pancakes are served in the village restaurant, De Hoeve.
v2-alt: Smithy at Museumdorp de Locht with anvils, hammers and a forge
v3-p1: Arcen is a quarter of an hour from De Locht. Hertog Jan brews its beer there, and from late March into the autumn the castle gardens, Kasteeltuinen Arcen, are open. If you walk around the museum village in the morning, there is still time for a brewery tour in the afternoon. From there it is just over twenty minutes back to Venray.
v3-alt: The Hertog Jan Brewery in Arcen with its terrace
tip: Go on a Sunday in autumn or winter. You can smell the syrup kettle from the entrance, and the blacksmith is often at work. Parking at the museum is free. Have a bowl of soup with Locht bread in De Hoeve and book a table with us for the evening, so there is nothing left to think about after the sauna.
g1-tekst: From November to March on Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday, 10.00 to 17.00. Closed from 16 November to 4 December 2026.
g1-alt: Tailor's workshop with sewing machines and a coat on a dress form at Museumdorp de Locht
g2-tekst: Adults €12.50, young people aged 7 to 18 €6.25. Free with the Museumkaart (Dutch museum pass). You can buy tickets online at delocht.nl.
g2-alt: Counter with scales and cabinets full of bottles in the chemist's shop at Museumdorp de Locht
g3-tekst: Dogs on a lead are welcome throughout the museum village. Parking is free.
g3-alt: Lawn and barns with a wind pump at Museumdorp de Locht
g4-tekst: The whole museum is wheelchair accessible. There is a lift in the farmhouse, and you can borrow a wheelchair.
g4-alt: Herb garden with red brick paths at Museumdorp de Locht
dag-sub: Breakfast at the hotel, the museum village in Melderslo during the day and back in the late afternoon for the sauna and dinner.
m1-tekst: The breakfast buffet is served from 07.00 to 10.00 on weekdays and from 08.00 to 10.30 at weekends. The museum opens at 10.00 and is a fourteen-minute drive away.
m1-alt: Breakfast buffet in the Hotel Asteria restaurant
m2-tekst: Allow half a day for the farmhouses, workshops, glasshouse and gardens. Have lunch in De Hoeve: soup with fresh bread from the bakehouse.
m2-alt: Oak tree and barn with a tiled roof at Museumdorp de Locht
m3-tekst: Back in Venray, warm up in the sauna. The wellness area is open Monday to Thursday from 16.00 to 22.00 and Friday to Sunday from 12.00 to 22.00. Tuesday is swimwear day.
m3-alt: Footbath in the wellness area on the Top Floor
m4-tekst: End the day at a table in the hotel brasserie. The kitchen is open until 21.30, and afterwards your room is just a lift ride away.
m4-alt: Bar in the Hotel Asteria brasserie
kamers-sub: After a day among the farmhouses and an evening in the sauna, your room is just a lift ride away. Choose your room; you see the price for your dates straight away when you book.
kaart-regel: Museumdorp de Locht lies south-east of Venray, between Horst and the river Maas. The map also shows three other days out nearby.
kaart-naam: Museumdorp de Locht, Broekhuizerdijk 16d, 5962 NM Melderslo
kaart-alt: Map of North Limburg with Hotel Asteria in Venray, Museumdorp de Locht and three other days out
f1-v: How far is Museumdorp de Locht from Hotel Asteria?
f1-a: It is 13.8 kilometres, about 14 minutes by car. By bike it is around 14 kilometres and takes about 55 minutes. You can hire bikes and e-bikes at our reception.
f2-v: How long does a visit to De Locht take?
f2-a: The museum does not give a set duration. With more than twenty buildings and gardens and lunch in De Hoeve, you can easily spend half a day there. So you are back in plenty of time for the wellness area.
f3-v: Is De Locht open in winter?
f3-a: Yes, but on fewer days. From November to March the museum is open on Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday and Sunday from 10.00 to 17.00. From April to October it is open every day except Monday. From 16 November to 4 December 2026 inclusive, the museum is closed for the Sinterklaasdorp (Saint Nicholas village).
f4-v: Do I need to buy tickets in advance?
f4-a: There is no need; you can buy tickets online at delocht.nl or at the entrance. Adults pay €12.50, young people aged 7 to 18 €6.25, and children up to 6 go free. Entry is free with the Museumkaart. These are the prices as of November 2026. Only the chapel concerts on Sundays need a separate ticket, which you buy online.
f5-v: Can I bring my dog to Museumdorp de Locht?
f5-a: Yes. Dogs are welcome on a lead, and so are assistance dogs.
f6-v: Can I still use the wellness area and have dinner at the hotel after De Locht?
f6-a: Yes. The museum closes at 17.00 and you are back after a fourteen-minute drive. The wellness area is open Monday to Thursday from 16.00 to 22.00 and Friday to Sunday from 12.00 to 22.00. Tuesday is swimwear day. You can have dinner in the brasserie until 21.30.

hertogjan.desc: In Arcen, ten minutes from De Locht, stands the Hertog Jan brewery. A guide takes you through the brewing process, from hops and malt to tasting the beer. Book a tour in advance. Bear in mind that you walk through narrow corridors and climb 144 steps.
hertogjan.credit: Photos: B. Hulshoff and Steven Lek via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0), cropped; photo of the tap: Hotel Asteria.

arcen.desc: Around a 17th-century castle on the Maas lie more than fifteen gardens: a rose garden, an oriental water garden and the tropical glasshouse Casa Verde. From De Locht you are there in a quarter of an hour. The gardens are closed in winter and reopen at the end of March.
arcen.credit: Photos: Vincent van Zeijst and Kasteeltuinen Arcen via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0), cropped.

maasduinen.desc: Along the east bank of the Maas runs the longest river dune ridge in the Netherlands, with over 4,500 hectares of woodland, heath, drift sand and fens. Pick your walking or cycling route at the visitor centre in Well. Even in winter it is a fine place for some fresh air before the sauna.
maasduinen.credit: Photos: Lieblingsgouda, Steven Lek, Carelbullens and Jonathation via Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA), cropped.
